tierUpgrade.productRoute: The cockpit's upgrade verb is a WebSocket control to a pinned agent, whose live sandbox hot-upgrade refuses on Kubernetes ('use the normal pause/redispatch path'); a stateless Session has no control socket and its config PATCH refuses a tier change (409). What remains is the owner config PATCH with a bare backend on a disconnected pinned Session, the same fragment the agent persists after a live upgrade.

liteTemplate.rootCause: select_execution_workspace resolves the template (LiveManifestResolver.selection -> shared/manifests/resolution.py:236-247, from b58616cf0 on 2026-09-09) before srw_workspace_config. For a virtual template with environment, cpu, memory or initialize the resolver raises ManifestError, a ValueError rather than an HTTPException: job admission's catch-all turns it into 500 and the preview routes leave it unhandled. The e6ab0cead unit test calls srw_workspace_config directly, so it never meets the resolver. The new wording is live but only for inputs the resolver lets through.
